finding.observed: GitHub documents that private-repository workflow-run listing requires repository read access and, for fine-grained tokens, Actions repository permission (read). The endpoint returns HTTP 200 on success and filtered searches can be capped at 1,000 results.
finding.inference: A zero-run response is admissible evidence only after authentication, repository identity, permission readiness, API-version, and rate-limit state are proven. Authorization or scope failures must never be normalized into an empty enumeration.
finding.current_decision: Run a no-secret readiness preflight before either exhaustive client. Bind the preflight to the repository and exact commit, retain only sanitized status and rate-limit metadata, and fail closed before enumeration when readiness is not proven.
finding.uncertainty: GitHub does not expose a universal response field that directly attests every effective token permission; readiness therefore combines successful authenticated repository access, a successful one-item Actions request, and explicit client-side credential-presence checks without retaining the credential.

documents.title: REST API endpoints for workflow runs
relevant_claims: Private repository access requires an authenticated token with suitable repository access.
Fine-grained tokens require Actions repository permission (read).
A successful list-workflow-runs response has HTTP status 200.
Filtered searches using head_sha and other named filters return at most 1,000 results.

documents.title: REST API endpoints for rate limits
relevant_claims: Authenticated clients can inspect current REST rate-limit state.
Rate-limit readiness is separate from authorization readiness.

steps: Validate the exact commit as 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Require the configured credential environment variable to be present and non-empty without reading it into retained output.
Request GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} and require HTTP 200 plus exact owner/name identity agreement.
Request GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?per_page=1 without search filters and require HTTP 200 plus a valid workflow_runs array.
Inspect rate-limit state or response headers and require remaining capacity above the configured traversal reserve.
Retain status codes, repository identity, API version, retrieval times, rate-limit category, remaining count, reset time, and a sanitized failure classification.
Never retain Authorization headers, tokens, cookies, command traces containing secrets, workflow names, actor identities, or run payloads during preflight.
Emit ready=true only when every readiness predicate passes.
preflight.ready_predicate: credential_present && commit_valid && repository_http_200 && repository_identity_matches && actions_probe_http_200 && actions_payload_valid && rate_limit_known && rate_limit_remaining >= traversal_reserve && no_secret_material_retained

test_vectors.name: private repository and Actions read access proven
repository readable but Actions permission unproven
authorization failure cannot become empty evidence

handoff.integration_point: Run before github-actions-ceiling-safe-enumeration-v1 and before both R-021 reconciliation clients.
handoff.promotion_rule: No enumerator output may be classified as exhaustive, empty, or promotable unless a matching ready=true preflight envelope is retained for the same repository, exact commit, API version, and execution window.

falsification_route: Run the preflight with a token that has repository metadata access but lacks Actions read permission and require rejection.
Run with an inaccessible repository and verify 404 is classified as authorization_or_visibility_unproven rather than zero runs.
Lower the rate-limit reserve above current remaining capacity and require pre-enumeration rejection.
Inject token-shaped strings into retained fixtures and require the secret scan to fail.
Revisit the contract if GitHub introduces a direct effective-permission attestation endpoint for the authenticated credential.

privacy.retention_rule: Retain only sanitized preflight metadata. Raw authenticated responses remain ephemeral unless separately approved for restricted evidence storage.
